analysis.title: GS Laicini - Prime HFs Intraday Update, AI Sell Off 15 Oct 2026
key_insights: Market and AI sell-off continues on 15 Oct 2026. Momentum factor is down 3.4 SD, Crowded Longs down 1.8 SD, and Crowded Shorts squeezing +1.2 SD, which GS reads as broader de-grossing.
Global Fundamental L/S managers are estimated down 0.9% (-1.2 SD) at 10:30am ET, down every day this week. The weekly drawdown is -2.9% and performance is +14.3% YTD.
Asia-focused funds are down 2.6% (-2 SD) on the day and 6.8% MTD. They are still up 17% YTD but 23% off the late-June peak of +40%.
TMT-focused funds are down 2.0% (-1.4 SD) on the day and 4.7% over the past two sessions. They are still up 14.8% YTD.
Global Systematic L/S managers are down 0.9% (-2.6 SD), mainly from European and Asian exposure. Momentum and crowding are among the key factor drivers. They are still up 20% YTD.
Multi-Strats (equity portfolio, 4.5x leverage) are down 1.2% (-2.2 SD), with momentum and crowding the top factor losses.
From COVID through end-2025, all three broad hedge fund strategies never fell more than 80bps on the same day. In 2026 this has happened three times: 4-Feb, 28-Jul and 15-Oct.
risk_factors: Continued de-grossing across hedge funds, with momentum and crowded-long losses alongside a squeeze in crowded shorts.
Asia-focused and TMT-focused funds are taking the largest drawdowns, with the AI sell-off as the stated driver.
vol_and_positioning: Momentum factor down 3.4 SD, Crowded Longs down 1.8 SD, Crowded Shorts +1.2 SD (squeezing), which GS reads as broader de-grossing.

Asia-focused funds down 2.6% (-2 SD) on the day, down 6.8% MTD, 23% off the late-June peak.
TMT-focused funds down 2.0% (-1.4 SD), down 4.7% in two sessions.
Global Systematic L/S down 0.9% (-2.6 SD), driven by European and Asian exposure.
Multi-Strats (4.5x leverage equity portfolio) down 1.2% (-2.2 SD).
A same-day drop of more than 80bps across all three broad hedge fund strategies has happened three times in 2026 (4-Feb, 28-Jul, 15-Oct), versus never from COVID through end-2025.
